analysis:
CHANGELOG.md is the only changed file in this batch. The base excerpt covers old lines 1447-1721 of earlier release notes. The head excerpt covers lines 1-228 and adds Unreleased and 0.9.x entries. I saw no executable, config, or workflow code, so no code-level security regression can be established from this batch. The changelog does describe behavior in other files that I did not see, so the integration pass should check it against the code diff.

Behaviors described in the head entries, and the threat IDs they touch:
- Soft-delete and account erasure (head lines 59-117): default-off EIGENINFERENCE_SOFT_DELETE_MUTATIONS_ENABLED, an erasure outbox, and fencing of late writes. T-059 covers this and TB-006 is the boundary.
- Frozen legacy MDM cohort (lines 218-228): enroll requires a linked provider token plus an SE-key proof. App Attest is required for noncohort owner routing and for base rewards. This matches the canonical TB-009 and TB-011 text.
- Provider-bound caller-field minimization (line 206): top-level user, metadata, safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key are stripped. This matches the canonical header note.
- Coordinator log PII removal (line 96): T-051 and T-003.
- Production App Attest serving validation (line 63) runs before the database or migrations. Its code is not visible to me.
- Open Sales Program referral rewards (lines 160-167): 5% withdrawable earnings funded by Darkbloom. Self-owned execution is excluded, but I saw no sybil-account or wash-trading analysis. Check whether the code diff or the threat model covers it.
- Bedrock/OpenRouter PR review with optional merge clearance (lines 13-21), listed as a separate rollout. Review-control changes require an independent formal override, so verify that gate in the workflow files.
- Other items: coordinator migration timeouts, the leaderboard 503 cooldown, and other topic entries.

I make no claim about unchanged callers or the code behind these notes.
